create_qwen2vl_video_processor: create a Qwen2VLVideoProcessor instance to dynamically resize and normalize video tensors for Qwen2-VL models
sample_frames_video_processor: sample uniformly spaced frames from a video using the Qwen2VLVideoProcessor.sample_frames method with fps or num_frames
get_num_of_video_patches: get the number of video patches for a given frame count, height, and width using Qwen2VLVideoProcessor.get_num_of_video_patches
preprocess_video_batch: preprocess a batch of video tensors by resizing, normalizing, and chunking into patches with Qwen2VLVideoProcessor._preprocess
build_video_processor_with_kwargs: build a Qwen2VLVideoProcessor with custom min_pixels, max_pixels, patch_size, temporal_patch_size, merge_size, min_frames, and max_frames
